top_choice_rationale: Kane-Mele Z2 invariant and the quantum spin Hall state introduced a new classification of time-reversal-invariant insulators, tested directly by Molenkamp's HgTe edge transport and reproduced across materials over roughly two decades. A change of conceptual category outweighs the improved measurement capability of the lattice clock (P001), which is cleaner in attribution but close to the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes. The Kane-Mele-Molenkamp trio follows the idea-to-test chain, with the exclusion of Hasan and Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang acknowledged as a limit of the three-person rule. P003 is scientifically real but its mechanisms remain unsettled; any award is preferred to no award.
